basic_info.description: Studio Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $104,900; 2 people = $119,900; 3 = $134,850; 4 = $149,850; 5 = $161,850. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, JULY 8th, 2024. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on July 29, 2024 at 5:00 PM. Fair Housing Opportunity. Open House Dates/Times: July 11, 6pm-8pm, July 14, 2pm-4pm, July 21, 2pm-4 pm. Spacious and sunny 9th-floor studio at 170 Off 3rd (170 King St.). This spacious & quiet studio, which overlooks a pool and landscaped garden, has hardwood floors, custom light fixtures, 2 closets with built-in storage. The kitchen area is functional with stainless steel appliances, gas stove, granite counters, & raised counter for eating. Building amenities include heated pool, hot tub, theater room, fitness center, club room, BBQ grills, and bike storage. Lottery 8/5/24 at 3 pm.
